spans.s:
उद्धन् {c2c} P. [उद्-हन्] To raise up,
elevate (fig. also); see उद्धत.

उद्धत p. p.
1 Raised up, elevated,
lifted up; लांगूलमुद्धतं धुन्वन्

.
--2
Excessive, very much, exceeding.
--3 Haughty, vain, puffed up;
अक्षवधोद्धतः

.
--6 Majestic, stately;
ill-mannered.
--तः A king's wrestler.
--Comp.
--मनस्, --मनस्क a.
high-minded, haughty, proud.

उद्धतिः f.
1 Elevation.
--2 Pride,
haughtiness; Śi. 3. 28.
--3
Rudeness, insolence; 16. 72.
--4 A stroke,
shaking.

उद्धम a. [उद्-ध्मा-श] Sounding,
blowing.
--मः
1 Sounding, blowing.
--2 Breathing hard, panting.

उद्धर्ष a. Delighted, glad.
--र्षः
1
Great joy or delight.
--2 Courage to
undertake a thing.
--3 A festival
(especially a religious one).

उद्धर्षण a. Animating,
encouraging, exciting; हितमुद्धर्षणं चैव उवाच
प्रथितं वचः Rām.
--णं
1 Animating.
--2 Erection of the hair (on the
body), thrill.

1 a. Encouraging.
--2
Ved. One whose hair is erect.

1 A sacrificial fire.
--2 A
festival, holiday.
--3 N. of a
Yādava, uncle and friend of Kṛṣṇa.
When Kṛṣṇa was taken by Akrūra
to Mathurā Uddhava was implored by
the citizens of Gokula to go and
fetch him. He was very much attached
to Kṛṣṇa. On seeing the destruction
of the Yādavas to be inevitable, he
went to Kṛṣṇa and asked him what
to do; whereupon he was told to
go to Badarikāśrama to practise
penance and to secure heaven. He
is the subject of two short poems,
उद्धवदूत and उद्धवसंदेश.

उद्धस्त a. Extending or raising
the hands.

To abandon or
expose (an infant).
--2 To set up, erect,
build. II. {c3c}

To go or move
upwards, rise (as the sun, dust &c.); यतो
रजः पार्थिवमुज्जिहीते

.
--2 To
go away from, depart;
उज्जिहानजीवितां

.
--3 To raise; शिरसा
यूपमुज्जिहीते Kāty.
--4 To throw up,
knit (as eyebrows);

उद्धान a.
1 Ejected, vomited.
--2
Inflated, corpulent, fat.
--3 Gone
up, ascended, risen.
--नं
1 A
fireplace.
--2 Ejecting, vomiting.

A
particular part of a carriage (the part
which rests on the axles).
--2 An
earthen stand on which the Ukhā
rests.
उद्धित p. p. Set up, erected.

उद्धांत a. Ejected, vomited.
--तः
An elephant out of rut (from whose
temples ichor ceases to flow).

उद्धुर a. [उद्गता धूरस्मात्]
1 Freed
from a burden or yoke,
unrestrained, unchecked, free.
--2 Firm,
intrepid, bold; अभियोग˚

.
--5 Heavy,
full of; Śi. 5. 64.
--6 Thick, gross.
--7 Lively, cheerful.
--8 Able,
competent;

.
--2 To shake or
throw off; Śi. 18. 8, dispel, destroy
(fig.), उद्धूतपापाः

उद्धूत p. p.
1 Shaken off, fallen
from; raised or thrown up;
मारुतभरोद्धूतोपि धूलिव्रजः Dhan. V.
--2
Exalted, high, loud.

1 Powdering,
sprinkling with dust or powder; भस्मोद्धूलन
K.

.
--2 An article
used to season food.

उद्धूलयति Den. P. To powder,
sprinkle with powder or dust.

उद्धूषणं Erection of the hair (on
the body), thrill, horripilation.

To draw out, raise
up.
--2 To save, deliver; भगवति
तव स्पृष्टानद्भिश्चिरादुददीधरत्

.
{vII.v} [उद्-हृ]
1 To draw or take out,
extract, extricate; शरं… उद्धर्तुमैच्छत्

; 3. 64; to deliver from,
relieve of, save, rescue, protect
(with abl.); मां तावदुद्धर शुचो
दयिताप्रवृत्त्या

.
--2 To uproot, extirpate, eradicate;
tear or pull out; नमयामास
नृपाननुद्धरन्

.
--4 To raise, lift up, elevate,
extend (as hands); पातयितुमेव
शक्तिर्नान्नपिटमुद्धर्तुं

; Śi. 3. 75.
--6
To sustain, bear up; राज्यधुरमुद्धर्तुं

.
--7 To separate, abstract.
--8 To
remove, put away.
--9 To deduct,
subtract.
--10 To select, pick out;

.
--13 To divide (as with partners).
--14 To publish, make known.
--Caus. To cause to extract or
draw out;

1 Drawing or taking out,
taking off (clothes &c.).
--2
Extraction, pulling or tearing out; कंटक˚

; चक्षुषोरुद्धरणं Mit.; so
शल्य˚
--3 Extricating, deliverance,
rescuing (from danger);
दीनोद्धरणोचितस्य

.
--4
Destruction, eradication,
extermination, deposition, dethronement;
चंद्रगुप्तस्योद्धरणात्

.
--5
Lifting, raising.
--6 Taking a part or
share.
--7 Taking from the
Gārhapatya fire to supply the other sacred
fires.
--8 Vomiting.
--9 Anything
vomited.
--10 Final emancipation.
--11 Acquittance of debt.

1 Raising, elevating.
--2
Rescuing, drawing out of
(danger), delivering.
--3 Sharing,
dividing.

उद्धर्तृ, उद्धारक a.
1 One who raises
or lifts up.
--2 A sharer, coheir.
--3 One who recovers property. --m.
1 A destroyer, exterminator;

उद्धर्तृ, उद्धारक a.
1 One who raises
or lifts up.
--2 A sharer, coheir.
--3 One who recovers property. --m.
1 A destroyer, exterminator;

1 Drawing out, extraction.
--2 Deliverance, redemption,
[]
saving, rescuing, extrication.
--3
Raising, lifting up.
--4 Deduction, a
part to be set aside.
--5 (In law)
A part to be set aside from the
paternal property for the benefit of
the eldest son; the surplus allowed
by Law to the eldest beyond the
shares of the younger brothers;

.
--6 The sixth part of
booty taken in war which belongs
to the king;

.
--7
An obligation.
--8 Debt,
particularly such as bears no interest.
--9
Recovering property.
--10
Marching out.
--11 Citing (a passage),
quoting.
--12 Final beatitude.
--13
Prosperity, elevation.
--रा The
plant गुडूची.
--रं A fireplace.

उद्धृत p. p.
1 Drawn up or out
(water), extracted &c.
--2 Raised,
elevated, lifted up, thrown up or
upwards; निक्षेपणाय पदमुद्धृतमुद्वहंती

.
--4 Separated, set
apart.
--5 Divided, partitioned.
--6 Selected.
--7 Dispersed,
scattered.
--8 Holding, containing.
--9
Uncovered.
--10 Vomited, cast up.
--Comp.
--उद्धार a. {1} one who has
received his share of the
patrimony. {2} that from which the
proper part has been deducted;

उद्धृतिः f.
1 Drawing or pulling
out, extracting.
--2 An extract,
passage selected.
--3 Delivering,
rescuing.
--4 Especially, delivering or
purifying from sin, final liberation;
त्रपंते तीर्थानि त्वरितमिह यस्योद्धृतिविधौ
G.

To breathe out,
puff, blow.
--2 To inflate, to make
known by blowing (a trumpet).
